name: adr-skill
description: Create or update Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) in /docs/decisions with deterministic numbering and consistent formatting.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a new ADR with auto-incremented number

capabilities.auto_numbering: Scans /docs/decisions/ to determine next ADR number
capabilities.slug_generation: Converts title to kebab-case filename automatically
capabilities.template_consistency: Uses fixed template structure for all ADRs
capabilities.validation: Checks title, filename, and format consistency
